product.description: Velora Prime 85mm f/1.4 delivers exceptional image quality for portrait and low‑light photography. The lens features a 9‑element, 7‑group optical design with an ultra‑fast f/1.4 aperture, enabling shallow depth of field and superior bokeh. A 12‑step manual focus ring provides precise control, while a built‑in focus limiter reduces focus travel. The robust metal barrel and rubberized focus ring offer durability and a comfortable grip. Compatible with Canon EF, Nikon F, and Sony E mount systems, the lens is versatile for both DSLR and mirrorless cameras. Its compact size and lightweight construction make it ideal for on‑the‑go shooting and studio work alike.
